svg.title: pt1 open-hardware USB debugging postcard
svg.desc: A light-mode 6 by 4 inch postcard introducing pt1 with a QR code linking to the getting-started documentation.

g.text: A pocket-sized bring-up bench for stubborn hardware.
Connect a target, open its console, cycle power,
and catch a fault through one host USB-C cable.
Three moves from workbench to first signal:
